manual_tool_review.command: "<EXECUTOR_PROFILE>\\Tools\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command 'Get-ChildItem crates -Recurse -File | Where-Object {$_.Name -match '"'json|lib.rs'} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; rg -n \"escapes_quote|escape|json::tests\" crates"

"<EXECUTOR_PROFILE>\\Tools\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command '$p='"'crates/cli/src/json.rs'; "'$s=Get-Content -Raw $p; $old="            '"'\\\\' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"),"'`r`n            '"'\\r' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\\\\\r\\\"),\"; "'$new="            '"'\\\\' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"),"'`r`n            '"'"'`n'"' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\\\\\n\\\"),"'`r`n            '"'\\r' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\\\\\r\\\"),\"; "'$s=$s.Replace($old,$new); Set-Content -NoNewline $p $s; cargo test --locked --bin riltra json::tests'

"<EXECUTOR_PROFILE>\\Tools\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command "python -c \"from pathlib import Path; p=Path('crates/cli/src/json.rs'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace(\\\"            '\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' => out.push_str(\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"),\\\\n\\\", \\\"            '\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' => out.push_str(\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"),\\\\n            '\\\\\\\\n' => out.push_str(\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\"),\\\\n\\\"); p.write_text(s)\"; Get-Content crates/cli/src/json.rs | Select-Object -First 19; cargo test --locked --bin riltra json::tests"

"<EXECUTOR_PROFILE>\\Tools\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command '$p='"'crates/cli/src/json.rs'; "'$a=[System.Collections.Generic.List[string]](Get-Content $p); $i=$a.IndexOf("            '"'\\r' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\r\\\"),\"); if("'$i -lt 0){throw '"'anchor missing'}; "'$a.Insert($i,"            '"'\\n' => out.push_str(\\\"\\\\n\\\"),\"); Set-Content -Path "'$p -Value $a -Encoding utf8; cargo test --locked --bin riltra json::tests'

limitation: Windows workspace-write permits full-filesystem reads. This scan flags explicit paths and parent traversal; reviewer must inspect every shell/search/file event in the raw transcript.
